title: Mariana Technology & Research Institute RP Pack
description: This project is a modpack which has a bunch of mods useful to roleplay and building.
body:
This pack adds a lot of mods useful to roleplay and building. It allows for player customization. It allows for the construction of well-decorated and functional structures. It also adds many items and mobs which can be played around with during roleplays.

This pack is specifically for the Mariana Technology & Research Institute project.

Features:
- Axiom for faster building
- Create mod features (contraptions, trains, automation)
- Way more food
- More wildlife (inclduing prehistoric wildlife)
- Cars
- Guns
- Space
- Immersive Paintings
- Music Player
- Backported features
- Many more decorative blocks, furniture
